context: JetBrains TeamCity is affected by different critical vulnerabilities such as CVE-2024-27198 (Authentication Bypass),  CVE-2024-23917 (Authentication Bypass), CVE-2024-27199 (Path Traversal), and CVE-2023-42793 (Remote Code Execution).

MariaDB 10.2 10.3 before 10.3.28 is affected by CVE-2021-27928 (Remote Code Execution);
